text:
maya: dropping a short UX thread on the policy editor snapshot comparison I mocked up. goal: make it easier to compare a draft reorder against live and spot validation differences quickly. mock: https://mock.redwood/dev/snap-compare-ux.png

eric: nice start. my first reaction: the side-by-side diff is heavy and forces horizontal scroll on smaller screens. can we collapse the right side into a flyout that slides over when you click "Compare snapshot"? that keeps the editor usable. :eyes:

tulsi: collapse/flyout sounds good. also request: when a rule differs between live and draft (e.g., priority change), show a tiny inline delta pill next to the title like "+priority" or "condition changed" so you can scan the list quickly.

kevin: accessibility note: those delta pills must have clear text alternatives (e.g., aria-label="Priority increased") and be keyboard-focusable. if the flyout opens, trap focus and label it clearly: role="dialog" aria-label="Snapshot comparison". include "Esc to close" in the header.

noah: validation behavior: when previewing a snapshot we currently surface errors as a global summary only. users want to jump from the summary to the offending rule. add anchors on the summary items that focus the rule card and open an inline inspector with the failing condition highlighted.

maya: yes — jump-to-failure is key. also add small badges for error types: "config error" vs "runtime mismatch". color-code (red/amber) but keep accessible contrast.

eric: UX microcopy: change the snapshot CTA text from "Compare" to "Compare with live" and add a short sublabel: "Shows differences in order, conditions, and simulation results." clear expectations.

tulsi: keyboard reorder: we talked about a bulk mode before. in snapshot compare it might be useful to have a "preview reorder" mode that lets you rearrange locally and see a diff against live without committing. support arrow keys once in that mode and show a persistent undo affordance.

kevin: announcer behavior for reorder preview: announce "Preview reorder: Rule X moved to position Y" using aria-live=polite. if user commits the reorder, announce "Committed reorder: Rule X moved to position Y". avoid assertive unless it's an error. debounce rapid moves to avoid SR spam.

noah: simulation playback when comparing: we have a scrubber in the mock that replays sample requests. add a "Highlight changed rules" toggle so when you scrub, the canvas highlights only rules that behaved differently between snapshots. makes triage faster.

maya: good idea. also annotate timeline markers with small dots for "first failure in live" and "first failure in draft" so you can jump to the step where behavior diverges. keyboard nav: n/p to go next/prev divergence.

eric: performance note: diffing many rules + traces can be heavy. lazy-load the right-side traces and only compute diffs for visible rules. show a skeleton shimmer for pending results.

tulsi: copy nit: when a rule has a simulation mismatch, change the badge copy from "Mismatch" to "Simulation mismatch — {short reason}" and include a short "Why?" link that expands a one-line explanation. reduces alarm.

kevin: color tokens: our amber for mismatches currently fails AA at small sizes. pick an amber-700 or add a dark outline for small chips. include this in the QA checklist.

noah: small interaction thought: when you click a failure in the summary it should not only focus the rule but also pre-fill the inspector with a compact sample request and a "Re-run sample" button so you can iterate quickly. keep the URL updated so people can share specific failure links.

maya: implementation plan: tulsi prototype the flyout + delta pills + Highlight changed rules toggle; eric will sketch the preview-reorder flow and skeleton states; kevin will produce the aria spec (dialog trapping, announcers, labels) and add contrast tokens to the checklist; noah will wire the inspector pre-fill + re-run sample and permalink schema. i'll update the mock and attach a short screencap later today.

design-bot: Task created: "policy-ux: snapshot compare flyout + jump-to-failure + preview-reorder" (EPIC-5127).

eric: one more small UX ask: when previewing reorder in the flyout, show a diff mini-map in the flyout header summarizing "3 rules moved, 1 changed condition, 2 simulation mismatches". helps people decide whether to commit.

tulsi: agree. minimap header + summary line is very helpful. i'll include it in the prototype.

maya: thanks all. i'll post updated link and brief notes once the prototype is up. closing thread until then.
